title: The Devil is a Part-Timer!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Defeated by the Hero Emilia, the Devil King Satan and his general Alciel flee their fantasy world and land in modern Tokyo, stripped of magic. Now living as Sadao Maou and Shiro Ashiya, they rent a tiny apartment and Maou works hard at a fast-food chain, aiming to make manager. Emilia follows, also stranded, and the former enemies become uneasy neighbors as angels and demons from their home world keep intruding.
life_message: Honest work, responsibility and caring for the people around you matter more than titles or past roles.
